model_annotation: The bar chart presents data on three different metrics: "训练集数" (Training Set Size), "验证集大小" (Validation Set Size), and "准确率" (Accuracy Rate), across five different categories: "实际识别" (Actual Recognition), "蔬菜识别" (Vegetable Recognition), "食品识别" (Food Recognition), "空间排列" (Spatial Arrangement), and "同义词识别" (Synonym Recognition). The training set size is represented by blue bars, while the validation set size is shown with orange bars. Accuracy rates are indicated by a grey line. The y-axis on the left measures the count for set sizes and label values, while the right y-axis measures the accuracy rate from 0 to 1. The training set size ranges from 1077 to 1210, with "实际识别" having the largest set size. The validation set size varies from 40 to 250, with "空间排列" having the smallest set size. The accuracy rate starts at 0.9 for "实际识别" and decreases to 0.2852 for "同义词识别". The bar chart does not provide information on the reasons for these values or trends.
